author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Classifies normalized public chat and optionally performs capped, creator-approved, platform-aware moderation through one triggerless controller.
changelog: 2.5.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial disabled-by-default observe-only release with literal, normalized-domain, link, caps, repeated-character, length, and repeat-message signals; stable-ID and role trust controls; temporary hashed link permits; bounded pseudonymous incident state; authenticated aggregate capability/status; non-persisting rule tests; and confirmed/false-positive review labels.

manifest.name: Chat Guard
installationSteps: Install Chat Guard and validate rules in Observe mode first.
To enforce, import its Streamer.bot package, keep Moderate triggerless, approve only its stable action ID, then explicitly approve enforcement in the wizard.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its private pseudonymous incident state remains preserved for a later reinstall or creator review.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded public-chat classification and fail-closed optional moderation dispatch are available.
